title: Hear humpback whales beneath your boat
description: Choose a whale-watching cruise with a marine naturalist and hydrophone, adding underwater song to the sight of whales in their winter habitat.
teaser: Watch humpback whales and listen for their underwater song.
goodToKnow: January and February are often good months for whale watching. Confirm boat access and sea conditions; whale behavior varies, and no swimming is needed.
whyItMightDelightYou: Choose a whale-watching cruise with a marine naturalist and hydrophone, adding underwater song to the sight of whales in their winter habitat.
